ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Журнал регистрации входящей корреспонденции
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.incoming_number AS inc_num, m.date_created AS reg_date, c.name AS sender_name, c.inn AS sender_inn, m.to_str1 AS subject, m.note AS execution_mark, m.status AS doc_state FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE m.date_created BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo AND m.incoming_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.date_created DESC;
